name: Itz'ana Resort
positioning: Beachfront and marina resort (officially Itz'ana Resort & Residences) on a white-sand beach in Placencia, Belize, with villas, penthouses and its own private island, Coral Caye
best_for: Families and groups wanting multi-bedroom villas with kitchens and plunge pools
Travelers who want boat trips, the barrier reef and a private island day from a marina on site

facts.text: Itz'ana is a beachfront and marina resort in Placencia, Belize.
The resort sits on a white-sand beach on the Caribbean Sea.
The beach villas have multiple bedrooms, kitchens, decks, plunge pools and Caribbean views.
The villa and penthouse interiors are by designer Samuel Amoia.
The One Bedroom Beachfront Villa has an outdoor bathtub and a rainforest shower.
The full-service marina has a watersports activity center, a refueling station and a supplies store.
The marina sits on the calm lagoon waters of Placencia.
Guests arriving by private boat or yacht can reserve a slip at the marina.
Coral Caye, the resort's private island, is off-grid and solar-powered.
Coral Caye is available for day trips, private island picnics and overnight stays.
Spa treatments can be arranged in the comfort of your suite or villa.
Limilia Restaurant serves seasonal, seafood-forward cuisine with vegetables and herbs from the resort's organic farm and fish line-caught by its own fisherman.

highlights.text: Coral Caye is a two-acre private island off the coast, with ocean-view cottages, a thatched dining pavilion and a dedicated island team.
The two- and three-bedroom penthouses sit above the resort with expansive terraces, private plunge pools and views across the resort and the Caribbean Sea.
The Two Bedroom Beach Villa has a plunge pool on its beachfront deck and an atrium garden with an indoor pool.
Guided yoga, breathwork and movement sessions take place directly along the Caribbean shoreline.
Resort experiences include rum and beer tastings, chocolate workshops, Garifuna cooking, hair braiding and drumming lessons.

considerations.text: The Belize Barrier Reef is about 14 miles offshore, a 40-minute boat ride to the dive site.
Advance reservations are recommended for private tours, sea excursions and guided cultural experiences.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires additional travel planning.
